methodology: The decomposition process involved analyzing each input document to identify distinct, self-contained requirements or features. Each atomic unit was defined based on its independence and specificity.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Detect pattern 1101 in serial input data.
Assert shift_ena for 4 clock cycles upon pattern detection.
Transition to counting state after shift_ena duration.
Wait for done_counting signal in counting state.
Assert done signal upon receiving done_counting.
Wait for ack signal to reset FSM.
Include active-high synchronous reset to initialize FSM.
spec_atomic_units: Monitor serial input data for pattern 1101.
Assert shift_ena for 4 clock cycles after pattern detection.
Transition to counting state post shift_ena assertion.
Remain in counting state until done_counting is high.
Assert done signal when done_counting is high.
Reset FSM upon ack signal assertion.
Implement active-high synchronous reset for FSM initialization.
